name: DropCap
description: Represents a dropped capital letter at the beginning of a paragraph. There is no DropCaps collection; each Paragraph object contains only one DropCap object.
remarks: Use the DropCap property to return a DropCap object. The following example sets a dropped capital letter for the first letter in the first paragraph in the active document.

properties.name: Application
properties.description: Returns an Application object that represents the Microsoft Word application.

properties.name: Creator
properties.description: Returns a 32-bit integer that indicates the application in which the specified object was created. Read-only Long.

properties.name: Parent
properties.description: Returns an Object that represents the parent object of the specified DropCap object.

properties.name: Position
properties.description: Returns or sets the position of a dropped capital letter. Read/write WdDropPosition.

properties.name: FontName
properties.description: Returns or sets a String that represents the name of the font for the dropped capital letter. Read/write.

properties.name: LinesToDrop
properties.description: Returns or sets the height (in lines) of the specified dropped capital letter. Read/write Long.

properties.name: DistanceFromText
properties.description: Returns or sets a Single that represents the distance (in points) between the dropped capital letter and the paragraph text. Read/write.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Removes the dropped capital letter formatting.

methods.name: Enable
methods.description: Formats the first character in the specified paragraph as a dropped capital letter.
